posts.title: Using Apple’s Foundation Models in Raku Sessions
posts.description: This blog post demonstrates how to use Apple’s Foundation Models (FM) in Raku sessions. It is designed for developers who want to integrate FM capabilities—such as text generation, image description, and structured data extraction—into Raku workflows, Jupyter notebooks, or computational Markdown documents.
